note.question: How can an online-learning system divide the cost of experimentation fairly across demographic or customer groups without giving up too much total performance?
note.overview: The paper formulates groups as bargaining agents, defines each group's surplus relative to operating alone, and applies the axiomatic Nash bargaining solution to allocate the burden of exploration. It is a cooperative-game-theoretic solution embedded in online learning.
